name: fill-bar
title: Fill bar
description: A labelled bar that fills to its value when it scrolls into view, for skills, quotas and survey results, built on Progress so the real value is always in the page.
docs: It renders the Progress primitive, so the progressbar role, its name and the true value are present from the first render and only the drawing animates. Give bars in a group an increasing order to land them in sequence. format is percent, value or fraction; pass valueText for anything else ("7.2 of 10 GB"). Use tone="muted" for the rows that are not the point and tone="destructive" for a limit that has been hit, and say so in the value text too. A value past max draws a full bar and one below zero an empty bar, while the text still shows the real number. Reduced motion, and a bar already on screen when the page hydrates, show the final width at once.
